answer_summary: The two [M+Na]+ degradation-product peaks are m/z 1299 and 1731. The neutral fragments are C78H84O16 and C105H112O21, obtained from one C22H25O4 enose end, one C2H3O2 acetoxy end, and respectively two or three C27H28O5 intact residues.
assumptions: The requested integer atomic masses are C=12, H=1, O=16, and Na=23.
The conventional structural abbreviation AcO denotes the attached acetoxy group CH3COO, with formula C2H3O2.
The [M+Na]+ ion has charge magnitude one, so its nominal m/z equals its nominal ion mass.
